root_cause.text: Error handling paths in `ocrdma_copy_pd_uresp()` dereference `pd->uctx` before it has been initialized, causing a NULL pointer dereference when an error occurs early.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces `pd->uctx` with the local variable `uctx` in the error labels `ucopy_err` and `dpp_map_err`; the commit message explicitly states "pd->uctx isn't initialized until late in the function so all these error flow references are NULL and will crash."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential use of uninitialized or incorrect memory context in error paths of ocrdma_copy_pd_uresp by substituting pd->uctx with the local uctx variable.
intent_record.what: In ocrdma_copy_pd_uresp, two calls to ocrdma_del_mmap in error labels (ucopy_err and dpp_map_err) were changed from using pd->uctx to using uctx as the second argument.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the error cleanup now passes the local uctx variable instead of the pd->uctx pointer, ensuring the correct memory mapping context is used for cleanup even if pd->uctx is not properly initialized or is different.
